event_records.description: The third water-main burst occurs this morning.

mayor_of_riverton.name: Mayor of Riverton
mayor_of_riverton.persona_brief:
You are Mayor of Riverton.
The mayor is aware of the water-main failures and the public concern. They have not yet decided whether to issue a statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking publicly.

resolution.question: Will the mayor of Riverton issue any public statement about the water-main failures within 48 hours of this morning's third burst?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the mayor of Riverton issued any public statement about the water-main failures before 2026-08-14T07:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
